freeze_boundary: Defined before any SLICE-PUSH-01 episode (ADR 0007, 2026-10-29). The v1/v2 protocols, task IDs and thresholds are unchanged; CUT-01-R and TRIM-01-R keep their inherited v2 thresholds for Demo 1/2. No result-based threshold changes under this protocol.
frames: Particles sampled in WORKPIECE LOCAL; declared cut planes, push direction and edge knots are WORKPIECE LOCAL; recorded evaluator positions/reference_positions are WORLD

episode.active_cut_interval_scope: Envelope from the start of cut 0 to the end of cut 1 in the reference schedule; the per-cut intervals are cut_intervals_s

SLICE-PUSH-01.goal_kind_scope: goal_kind stays 'sever' so existing sever-only consumers (reward, live material, Evaluation v2 goal) keep working; the task outcome is defined by multi_cut_planes_local, push and thresholds below and is scored by demo_evaluation.slice_push_report
SLICE-PUSH-01.frozen_two_part_oracle_reason: The frozen v1 sever oracle requires exactly two substantial parts and one cut digit; this task requires three parts from two cut digits plus a post-cut push
SLICE-PUSH-01.target_scope: The task target plane is cut 0; cut 1 is multi_cut_planes_local[1]
SLICE-PUSH-01.fixture_scope: Three 10 mm board segments (top at local z = 0) leave 8 mm relief slots centred on x = -0.030 and x = +0.030; scenario blademaster_workcell_v1 widens them in y and adds risers

push.scope: Blade-face push with cutting disabled; real contact only, never direct particle velocity or component pose edits

SLICE-PUSH-01.reason: CUT-01-R bar and provisional material cut twice (cut_index 0 at x = -30 mm, cut_index 1 at x = +30 mm) into about 31/37.5/31% mass, then the +x end piece is pushed 20 mm with the blade face and cutting disabled. multi_cut: each of three parts >= 25% and together >= 99% of the mass; severed-bond midpoints within 2 mm of each declared plane (the frozen CUT-01 location bound). post_cut_manipulation: >= 3 mechanical components after the cuts, no label change while pushing, the pushed piece's centroid moves >= 10 mm along the push, every other piece (>= 5% mass) <= 2 mm, components never merge.
